parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the toggle or actuator part of the wall switch, typically made of durable plastic for insulation and ease of use.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the user interface for turning the electrical circuit on or off by toggling or pressing.
parts.Movement_description: It moves rotationally or linearly depending on the switch design, allowing electrical contact to open or close.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base plate or mounting body of the wall switch, typically made of stainless steel or another rigid material for structural support.
parts.Functional_description: It provides mechanical support and houses the internal electrical components, securing the switch to the wall.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during operation.
